name: FUN_BC_TRX_HISTORIES
description: This table stores the execution histories of the  transactions in blockchain network.The  transactions contain querying data and writing transaction to ledger.

columns.name: TRX_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the tranaction history.

columns.name: EXECUTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the interface execution.

columns.name: APPLICATION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the application and it's  source is application table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_CODE
columns.description: Code of the connection, such as InvoiceFactoring.

columns.name: APPLICATION_VERSION
columns.description: The version of the application.

columns.name: CONNECTION_NAME
columns.description: Connection name of the execution.

columns.name: CONNECTION_DETAIL
columns.description: Connection attributes of the execution.

columns.name: CHAINCODE_METHOD_NAME
columns.description: Chaincode method of thie execution.

columns.name: INTERFACE_NAME
columns.description: Interface name of this execution.

columns.name: INTERFACE_INPUT
columns.description: Interface input of this execution.

columns.name: INTERFACE_OUTPUT
columns.description: Interface output of this execution.

columns.name: EXECUTION_SUCCESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the execution is successful.

columns.name: EXECUTION_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: If execution occurs error, store the error code.

columns.name: EXECUTION_DETAIL
columns.description: Log detail of the execution and may contains execution tracking info.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
